services.name: Kayak Rental
services.desc: Kayak with the otters, sea lions and seals on the Monterey Bay About Discover otters, sea lions and seals on the Monterey Bay with a sea kayak! Paddle through the kelp forest canopy along Cannery Row and experience the Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary. You may be greeted by harbor seals swimming alongside you or resting sleepily on the rocks along the shore. Or you may witness a raft of otters rolling and playing in the kelp! Kayakers get an up close look at this wonder of nature teeming with marine Ages 5+

services.name: Paddle Board Rental
services.desc: Today’s latest surf craze is stand up paddleboards! Do you want to try Standup Paddleboarding? Get out on the water and have some fun! Experience gliding on the water’s surface using a large long board built for stability. You propel yourself with what is essentially a long canoe paddle and you are off – this is as close as it gets to “walking on water”. If you’ve ever wanted to try your hand at this up and coming sport, we have you covered! Whether you want a rental or a lesson, we have the equipment and instructors to get you out on the water. No matter if you are young or old, Experience the beauty of Monterey Bay!

blurb: Adventures by the Sea is the premier recreational company on the Monterey Peninsula in California. For over 35+ years, Adventures by the Sea has been providing visitors and locals the opportunity to discover Monterey by land and by sea! We have five locations throughout the Monterey Peninsula, and our shops offer the best locations to start your kayaking or biking adventures from.
